**Implementation plan:**

| Area | Work |
|------|------|
| **WebSocket** | `ws` package, `wsService.js` — broadcast `order_book_snapshot`, `order_placed`, `order_filled`, `circuit_breaker` events |
| **Idempotency** | `idempotencyStore.js` — in-memory map with 24h TTL, 409 on payload mismatch |
| **Circuit breaker** | `circuitBreakerService.js` — per-symbol 5% price-band, auto-reset after 30s, `GET /api/circuit-breakers` endpoint |
| **Fee worker thread** | `feeWorker.js` — busy-wait runs in worker thread so event loop stays free; sync `computeFee` kept for test compat |
| **Execution engine** | `executionEngine.js` — 100–500ms fill simulation, transitions orders to `filled`, broadcasts `order_filled` |
| **Tests** | 5 new test files: idempotency, circuit breaker, WebSocket, execution, REST shape regression |
